articles.title: Hidden in Your DNA: Two Secret Ancestors Scientists Just Found!
articles.summary: Scientists found traces of two unknown ancient human groups hiding in our DNA. One ghost ancestor lived in Africa over 50,000 years ago and its DNA is in everyone alive today.

articles.title: Could a 1960s Space Toy Blast Into a Movie? Meet Major Matt Mason!
articles.summary: Major Matt Mason, a bendy astronaut toy from 1966, might become a movie. Tom Hanks was once attached to star, and with Mattel making more toy-based films, this space hero could get his chance.

articles.title: Honeycomb on Mars? Curiosity Rover Finds a Bizarre Patterned Landscape!
articles.summary: NASA's Curiosity rover spotted a huge field of honeycomb-shaped cracks on Mars. The polygons are about 1.5 to 3 inches wide and cover the ground as far as the rover can see.
